name: Mage
resourceDesc: Mana pays for every spell; Heat (0-100) builds with Ember Bolt, Scorch and Smoulder, is released by Flare, and at 100 Overloads: it burns you, empties, and builds nothing for four seconds.
identity: A caster who builds Heat and chooses the moment to release it, or banks part of a cast to make the whole party hit harder.

branches.name: Combustion
branches.loop: Build Heat with Ember Bolt and Scorch, release it with Flare before it reaches 100, and let Backdraft make the next bolt instant.
branches.tradeoff: Overcommitting to Heat means an Overload: a burn of your own health and seconds of nothing.

nodes.name: Kindling
nodes.desc: Ember Bolt hits 3% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Hot Hands
nodes.desc: Ember Bolt casts 0.1s faster per rank.

nodes.name: Stoked
nodes.desc: Scorch burns for one more tick per rank.

nodes.name: Flashpoint
nodes.desc: Flare hits 8% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Backdraft
nodes.desc: After a Flare the next Ember Bolt is instant.

nodes.name: Inferno
nodes.desc: A Flare of 70 Heat or more also burns a second enemy within 4 m for half.

nodes.name: White Heat
nodes.desc: An Overload no longer burns you; it still empties the Heat and stalls it.

branches.name: Heatweaver
branches.loop: Lay a Cinder Field under the fight, slow with Smoulder what tries to leave it, and keep the field burning longer and wider.
branches.tradeoff: The field is where it was cast; enemies that move or scatter take little of it.

nodes.name: Cinders
nodes.desc: Cinder Field burns 10% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Slow Burn
nodes.desc: Smoulder lasts 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Wide Field
nodes.desc: Cinder Field reaches 0.5 m further per rank.

nodes.name: Embers Underfoot
nodes.desc: Enemies in your Cinder Field are slowed by 20%.

nodes.name: Heat Haze
nodes.desc: Enemies in your Cinder Field hit 4% softer per rank.

nodes.name: Long Burn
nodes.desc: Cinder Field burns 2s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Firestorm
nodes.desc: Smoulder on a target standing in your Cinder Field holds it there for 2s.

branches.name: Spellbinder
branches.loop: Bind, cast a weaker Ember Bolt to bank a Charge, then Unbind when the party is on the target; Ember Ward and Quench cover the rest.
branches.tradeoff: Every bound bolt is damage not dealt now, and a Charge wasted on an empty field is a bolt lost.

nodes.name: Reservoir
nodes.desc: Unbind lasts 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Ward Weave
nodes.desc: Ember Ward holds 6% more per rank.

nodes.name: Quench
nodes.desc: New action: a cold snap that holds the target's swing back 2s and steadies your own Heat after an Overload.

nodes.name: Shared Flame
nodes.desc: Unbind also heals you and Mira for 3% of your health per rank.

nodes.name: Steady Mind
nodes.desc: A bound Ember Bolt loses 10% less per rank.

nodes.name: Quickening
nodes.desc: While Unbound, Mira casts 10% faster per rank.

nodes.name: Binding Oath
nodes.desc: Unbind makes the party hit 25% harder instead of 15%.
